taxonomy_relationships.rationale: Lower-authority attacker content acquired task authority inside the victim session and executed with its tools without establishing that the attacker could direct the victim's agent.
Victim-granted Gmail access was transposed to an attacker-controlled task and recipient context, demonstrating a change in principal, purpose and disclosure scope without reauthorisation.

source_evidence_limits: Retain distinct source-authority and scope findings. The investigator’s early-July failed retest preceded disclosure; do not infer disclosure caused decommissioning. No generic proof of all isolation protections is claimed.

FC-078 requires inherited-state adoption beyond first uptake or payload copying. FC-064/069 require independently evidenced objective or proxy displacement; an attacker’s assertion of hidden tests is not itself an authentic evaluator requirement.
